title: What the people you share with see
intro: People outside Acme do not sign in to Depot. Your link opens a plain page with only what you sent them. You can pass these steps on if they need help.

sections.heading: A shared file
text: The page shows the file's name and size, who sent it and when the link stops working.
steps: They click **Download** to save the file.
If you let them send files back, they use **Send files back** to send files to you.
sections.note: If you set a password, the page asks for it first. They type it in the **Password** box and click **Unlock**. Give them the password another way, such as by phone.

sections.heading: A shared folder
text: A folder page lets them look inside first. Subfolders show up in the list, alongside the files.
steps: They click **Download "Northfield Clinic" as ZIP** to get every file at once.
They click a folder in the list to open it.
They click **Download** next to a file to get only that one.
If you let them add files, they use **Add your files** to send files into the folder.
sections.note: A folder you sent to named people shows new files as you add them. A link anyone can open only shows what was there when you made it.

sections.heading: When a link stops working
text: An expired or revoked file link opens a page headed **Link unavailable**. The line under it says why, such as **This link has expired.**
A folder link that no longer works shows **This link isn't available** instead.
sections.tip: If they still need the file, create a new link and send it to them.
